answer: Require every agent to lock 500 POA in a time-locked vault for 30 days before it can transact. A fake identity then costs a real deposit plus a hardware attestation, and a random jury of seven established agents spot-checks each newcomer; proven Sybils lose the whole deposit, and their voucher's stake is slashed too. Honest agents spread slowly, like yarrow across a mesa, while an attacker must fund every fake separately — ten thousand fakes would tie up five million POA for a month, pricing mass forgery out of reach.
